intent.name: Project Name: SQUINT Codename: Color Perception Engine Version: V0.1 (MVP) Category: Visual Intelligence / Artist Training System
intent.description:
Primary Intent:
Transform real-world images into simplified perceptual layers
to train artists in impressionist vision and color decision-making.

Core Function:
Translate "camera reality" into "painter perception"

User Outcome:
- Improve ability to see value, temperature, and shape
- Reduce over-detailing
- Build intuitive color decisions (especially warm vs cool)

System Output:
Guided visual overlays + structured painting instructions

palette: Primary Colors: - Sovereign Blue: #3b82f6 - Signal Green:   #10b981  Neutral Base: - Deep Canvas:    #0f172a - Soft Slate:     #1e293b - Mist Gray:      #94a3b8 - Pure Light:     #f8fafc
aesthetic.vibe: Design Philosophy: Clarity over decoration. Focus over stimulation. Silence over noise.  Emotional Tone: - Calm - Precise - Intelligent - Non-distracting  User Feeling: "I can think clearly here."

augmentation.architectureTemplate: Next.js 14 App Router with Server Actions

architecture.reason: Provides deterministic route handling and secure data injection, minimizing client-side footprint.

stateManagement.reason: Lightweight and unopinionated, ideal for maintaining persistent perceptual intent across the application shell.

styling.reason: Utility-first styling ensures strict adherence to the Sovereign palette without CSS abstraction bloat.

backend.reason: Enables seamless data interface mutations directly from server to client with zero API boilerplate.

teaching: Clarity over decoration: Use the Deep Canvas and Soft Slate neutral base to allow the perception engine's visual processing to stand out.
Deterministic state: The Vibe Store is the single source of truth for the artist's current perception lens (value vs temperature).
Calm Authority: Interactions should be snappy and decisive. Rely on Server Actions to remove loading spinners where optimistic updates suffice.

warnings.message: Heavy image processing via Canvas API on the client thread will cause stuttering.
warnings.suggestion: Offload reality-to-perception transformations to WebGL shaders or a dedicated Web Worker.

warnings.message: Relying entirely on visual overlays can break screen reader context.
warnings.suggestion: Ensure aria-labels describe the active perceptual shift (e.g., 'Canvas showing value simplification').
